title: Payouts & Earnings
description: Manage host payouts and track your commission earnings

collected.label: Total Collected
collected.long: The sum of everything guests paid for their bookings during the selected period.

commission.label: Commission (12%)
commission.short: What the platform earns per booking.
commission.long: The percentage the platform charges for each completed booking. This amount represents your earnings as a platform.

payable.label: Payable to Hosts
payable.long: The amount you must pay hosts for completed bookings, after deducting the platform commission.

paid.label: Paid Out
paid.long: The total payments you've already made to hosts. These bookings have been settled.

outstanding.label: Outstanding Balance
outstanding.long: The amount still pending to be sent to hosts. Once you process the payment, it will automatically move to "Paid Out".

empty.pendingDesc: Once bookings are completed, they will appear here for you to process host payments.
empty.historyDesc: Payments you make to hosts will be recorded here along with their method and receipt.

confirmDialog.title: Confirm payment
confirmDialog.descriptionSingle: Mark this booking as paid to the host?
confirmDialog.notesPlaceholder: Reference number, receipt, or other info...

error.title: Error
error.description: Could not load data. Try reloading the page.
